name: Interactive Brokers
tagline: IBKR account sync: sign in, Flex, or Gateway
description: Account and position sync for Interactive Brokers. Sign in with IBKR in your browser to sync positions, balances and history and send orders to IBKR for review, or use the Flex Web Service. Owns the IBKR broker profile; install IBKR Gateway alongside it for live data and trading.
